copy.headline: Fair Park streets dedicated in honor of 2 leaders from African American Museum in Dallas
copy.caption: Two streets in Fair Park are now dedicated to two leaders from the African American Museum in Dallas: Dr. Harry Robinson Jr. and Richard Knight Jr.
